title: Azhwar Vaibhavam - 4
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: Chola Empire, which is said to be very special and rich in all of its production, was surrounded by the Cauvery River, made the chozha empire very beautiful and vegetative. Beautiful lakes, small rivers, which surrounds the green vegetative lands are found, which is one of the special vision to be seen.
